title: Rectified Linear Unit Regression
abstract: arXiv:2605.30609v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a regression framework for analyzing integrated conditional distribution and quantile functions. The proposed method, termed rectified linear unit (ReLU) regression, projects the ReLU-transformed outcome onto covariates and admits a closed-form estimator. Its population regression function is the best linear approximation to the integrated conditional distribution function of the outcome, and the corresponding convex conjugate, obtained via the Legendre-Fenchel transform, approximates the integrated conditional quantile function. Both the regression and its conjugate require only mild distributional assumptions and accommodate non-continuous outcomes. We establish the asymptotic distribution of the estimator and develop inference for the conjugate functional via the delta method for Hadamard directionally differentiable maps. Building on these results, we establish identification and inference for average quantile

translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.30609v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：本文开发了一个用于分析综合条件分布和分位数函数的回归框架。所提出的方法，称为修正线性单元（ReLU）回归，将ReLU变换后的结果投影到协变量上，并允许闭式估计器。其总体回归函数是结果变量的综合条件分布函数的最佳线性近似，而相应的凸共轭，通过勒让德-费涅尔变换获得，近似于综合条件分位数函数。回归及其共轭仅需温和的分布假设，并适用于非连续结果。我们建立了估计器的渐近分布，并通过哈达玛方向可微映射的德尔塔方法开发了共轭泛函的推断。基于这些结果，我们建立了平均分位数的识别和推断。
tldr: 本文提出了一种ReLU回归方法，通过闭式估计器近似综合条件分布和分位数函数，仅需温和假设并支持非连续结果，同时建立了渐近推断理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a ReLU regression method with a closed-form estimator that approximates integrated conditional distribution and quantile functions, requiring only mild assumptions and accommodating non-continuous outcomes, while establishing asymptotic inference theory.
